description: Vélocité - Panneaux B22 et B23 - Liège is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Le jeu de données reprend la liste ainsi que la géolocalisation des panneaux autorisant les cyclistes à franchir un feu rouge: pour tourner à droite (panneau B22) pour continuer tout droit (panneau B23) Pour en savoir plus sur cette initiative, rendez-vous sur www.liege.be Les informations sont régulièrement vérifiées par nos services sur le terrain. Coverage: Liège. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are b22, b23, vélo, mobilité, mobilité douce. The portal shows 84 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-11-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
